description: A Flutter widget implementing a chat interface with Rasa integration, handling message sending, rendering chat bubbles, and managing UI state.

classes.name: ChatPageScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the chat screen with state management for messages, input, and communication with Rasa backend.

classes.name: _ChatPageScreenState
classes.description: State class for ChatPageScreen, managing UI state, message list, input controls, and async communication with Rasa.

methods.name: sendCurrentComposerMessage
methods.description: Captures input text, updates UI with user message, clears input, and triggers async message sending to Rasa.

methods.name: _sendToRasa
methods.description: Asynchronously sends user message to Rasa server, handles responses or errors, and updates message list accordingly.

methods.name: _newId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID based on current timestamp and random number for message identification.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up controllers, focus nodes, and network client references.
